verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a first-party Marketplace whose listings include datasets from its partner ecosystem, which customers discover, evaluate and connect to directly from their workspace. OpenSharing (Delta Sharing) provides the underlying cross-organization data sharing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how acquired third-party datasets land in Unity Catalog and are joined with an analyst's own tables (the enrichment workflow is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience.
